annotations.title: Get the status of a payment intent

description: Read-only status of a payment intent (quoted / authorized / submitted / confirmed / failed) with its on-chain transaction hash once settled. Pass include_receipt=true to also fetch the signed EIP-712 receipt when the intent is confirmed. Use to poll after submit_payment when cryptographic verification is not needed; use verify_payment for full receipt verification.

include_receipt.description: Also fetch the signed receipt when the intent is confirmed (default false).

payment_intent_id.description: Payment intent ID returned by quote_payment.

name: phantom_get_payment_status

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
